scripts.infra:up: npm run observability:up && docker compose up -d --wait redis rabbitmq payment-postgres
scripts.infra:down: docker compose stop redis rabbitmq payment-postgres
scripts.docker:up: npm run observability:up && docker compose --profile app up -d --build --wait
scripts.docker:start: npm run observability:up && docker compose --profile app up -d --no-build --pull never --wait
